name: ux-project
description: UX discovery partner for designers — turn raw PM PRDs into KB-grounded ux-onepage (md + HTML 一图流) through a 3-phase gated workflow (Understand & Expand → Evaluate & Converge → Sharpen & Ship). v0.4 adds: strong phase gates with designer confirmation, scenario expansion lenses, JTBD evaluation rubric, online-behavior baseline memory, IA structure + interaction flow output (B&W, no UI details), and a self-contained HTML 一图流 deliverable. Preserves v0.3 cite-or-die, context-memory, stale detection, and AskUserQuestion UI. Does NOT generate hi-fi UI, visual styling, or Figma artifacts — those remain downstream.
